adjudication_rules: Exact unanimous values were preserved field-by-field.
Scalar 2-1 disagreements were decided from the rubric and case evidence, not by simple majority when the minority better matched the rubric.
List disagreements were adjudicated to sorted canonical tokens with every required item included in the allowed list.
Rationale disagreements were adjudicated by writing a final rationale that explains the governing route, ratings, and revision/question consequences.
Image cases retain no-image-token-guess and keep unrecoverable visual content as placeholders rather than inferred facts.
